what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Algeria, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's latest figure for people displaced by conflict and violence is 2540, for 2016.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Algeria in every year from 2003 to 2018 and in 2020, with AQIM among the opponents.
IDMC's disaster records for Algeria list floods, mass movements and wildfires.

when.text: In 2016, the main year of displacement in the data, IDMC recorded 2800 new displacements by conflict and violence.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 3083 new displacements by disasters, also counting movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Algeria.
